note: V_0.1.2: Patch bump — security fixes, a contract alignment and repository hygiene. No Domain Contract change, so no System bump. (1) D-005 provider alignment: GET /v1/apikey/status advertised 4 providers while PROVIDER_REGISTRY supported 2, so a user could register a key that could only ever fail; the advertised set is now derived from the registry (single source of truth) and a third stale copy in types.ts was deleted. Already-stored keys for a de-advertised provider deliberately remain visible so they stay deletable. (2) Five credential leaks into log sinks, found by a full sweep of all 91 log call sites: live JWT and Google OAuth code into request_logs.query_params; client_secret + refresh_token + Bearer via raw GaxiosError; the OAuth client_secret via raw Boom error (Authorization: Basic, base64 is not encryption); raw req.query in weather routes; unsanitized URL into raw_logs. One mechanism (projectErrorForLog / redactQueryParams / sanitizeRequestUrl over a single REDACTED_QUERY_PARAMS list), not five. Key finding: pino's redact.paths '*' is a single-level wildcard and does NOT protect err.config.headers.authorization. (3) Correlation id unified — pino reqId and request_logs.req_id were unrelated values, so a log line could not be joined to its DB row. (4) node_modules untracked (2948 files; it was in .gitignore but tracked from before the rule). Evidence: npm test 230 passing / 68 suites, tsc/test:types/build exit 0, npm audit 0 vulnerabilities. Each leak fix is mutation-verified. NOT verified: no live provider credential, no live database round-trip — integration verification remains outstanding. Open logging decisions recorded in docs/policies/logging_policy.md. Prior baseline: V_0.1.1 (2026-09-14, commit 224a6e9).
